description: A customer loads a snapshot taken at 2026-09-10T12:30:20Z. The export file finishes writing at 12:30:50. The August revision becomes available at 12:30:40, between the two.

snapshot.reason: The snapshot contains the same revisions as the full-history result as of September 4; nothing became available in between.

correct_handoff.reason: The position belongs to the same instant as the snapshot, so the revision is applied after loading.

incorrect_handoff.reason: A position taken when the file finished writing is already past the revision. The revision is absent from the snapshot and never read from the stream.

naive_incremental_query.reason: Asking only for periods after the last downloaded period returns nothing, so the revision to August is missed even though every request succeeds.
